action_items: MINOR / SPEC-vs-FIXTURE DRIFT: The review request stated FRANCHISEE_LEGAL_NAME appears on pages 1, 3, 4, 4 (4 occurrences → 3 later targets for duplicate-all-later). The live Paloma fixture actually has only 2 occurrences (p1, p3). Duplicate-to-all-later therefore shows 'APPLY TO 1' target (page 3), not 3. Behaviour is correct given actual data — either the fixture drifted or the spec paragraph was aspirational. No code fix required; consider re-uploading a richer fixture if 4-occurrence coverage is needed. All other spec-implied counts (7 occurrences, 2× AGREEMENT_DATE, 1× MONTHLY_FEE, 1× FRANCHISEE_ORGANISATION, 1× FRANCHISEE_ADDRESS_BLOCK) match reality.
critical_code_review_comments: MarkerReviewModal.jsx has grown from 732 → 1025 lines with Turn C.5 + D additions (SelectField, DuplicateConfirm dialog, AuditLogDrawer, evidence-pack toolbar button). This now clearly exceeds the 700-line soft cap — recommend splitting into src/pages/marker_review/{MarkerPropertyPanel,DuplicateConfirm,AuditLogDrawer,SubstitutionAckPanel,OccurrenceList,ModalShell}.jsx. Not blocking Turn D sign-off but should be scheduled before next feature layer.
Duplicate confirm dialog correctly disables mr-dup-apply when affected_count=0 (verified in code path); no regression against 1-target flows.
Audit drawer renders JSON extras with JSON.stringify pretty-print (2-space indent) — good UX. Consider adding a search/filter box once the log grows past ~50 rows.

Evidence Pack ZIP generation is triggered client-side via a signed URL that streams the archive; no error banner appears on trigger and download filename includes template slug + UTC timestamp — good traceability. The audit entry captures preview_bytes (820,944 bytes ≈ 800 KB) which is a healthy sanity signal.
token_bbox invariant still enforced (pointer-events:none, red border, zIndex 6 under Rnd's 7/8). Verified via computed-style probe post-duplicate — no regression.

Pre-existing React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') persists inside mr-add-code-select because the Emergent preview instrumentation wraps <option> children with <span data-ve-dynamic>. This is dev-preview-only noise (not present in production build), already documented in iteration_49. Safe to ignore.
